title: Flexible Tour with nice tapas
text: We had a fabulous day with Philip, even after a rocky start when a few guests showed up with non-existent reservations they made through Get Your Guide. But the guys figured out how to take care of everyone and we took off. Philip customized our tour to our interests, and got us a table at a nice tapas bar to sample some traditional snacks and wine. Great day!
author: Lisa_O

title: E-scooter fun and friendly tour
text: Really good fun and the guide Philip was friendly and informative- a must do way of seeing the city and learning about the history
author: michelle_a
